notes: Contract generated from backend SQLAlchemy models only; no external DB was accessed.
Index matching in verify_schema.py is by column signature + uniqueness, not by index name, because Alembic/model naming conventions differ.

Empty model stubs (e.g. inventory_*, media_*, chatbot_*, etc.) intentionally declare only id/created_at/updated_at in the backend code; any columns the real database has on those tables are reported as EXTRA COLUMN.
